declarations.description:
A layout shell with a navigation drawer beside the page content. The drawer goes in the `side-nav-content` slot, the
page in the default slot, and the host stretches both to its own height. In `side` mode the drawer collapses in the
flow and pushes the content; in `over` mode it slides over the content with a backdrop, locks page scrolling, traps
focus as a dialog and closes on Escape or a backdrop click. Phones always use `over`; `tablet-mode` and
`desktop-mode` pick the mode for the two larger breakpoints (600px and 960px), and the drawer remembers whether it
was open when the viewport crosses them.

Any element inside the side nav (drawer or content) carrying a `side-nav-toggle` attribute toggles the nearest enclosing side nav when
clicked, so a menu button in the page or a collapse button in the drawer header needs no script. With a non-zero
`--c2-side-nav__close--width` the collapsed drawer becomes an icon rail; the reflected `opened` attribute lets your
CSS hide the labels in that state (`c2-side-nav:not([opened]) .label { display: none }`).
declarations.name: SideNav

cssProperties.description: Width of the collapsed drawer; a non-zero value gives a rail.
cssProperties.name: --c2-side-nav__close--width

cssProperties.description: Line between the drawer and the content, on whichever side the drawer is.
cssProperties.name: --c2-side-nav__divider--width

cssProperties.description: `absolute` keeps the overlay inside a positioned parent.
cssProperties.name: --c2-side-nav__over--position

slots.description: The drawer content: a `c2-list` of links, a logo, anything.
slots.name: side-nav-content

slots.description: The page content beside the drawer.
slots.name: default

members.name: opened
members.description: Whether the drawer is open. On phones (and on tablets unless `tablet-mode` is set explicitly) the initial value is ignored and the drawer starts closed.

members.name: desktopMode
members.description: How the drawer behaves at 960px and up: `side` pushes the content, `over` slides above it.

members.name: tabletMode
members.description: How the drawer behaves between 600px and 959px.

members.name: responsiveTablet
members.description: Also collapse the drawer on tablets in `side` mode when the viewport shrinks to that size.

members.name: position
members.description: Which edge the drawer is on: `start` (left in LTR) or `end`.

members.name: preferredOpened
members.description: The state the user wants in `side` mode, restored when the viewport grows back.

members.name: mode
members.description: The mode in effect for the current viewport: `over` on phones, otherwise `tablet-mode` / `desktop-mode`.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Opens or closes the drawer as a user action would (fires `opened-change`).

members.name: closesOnLoadAt
members.description:
On load the `opened` attribute is meant for the layout the author designed for: it is ignored on phones and for the
implicit tablet overlay, but honoured when an overlay mode was chosen explicitly (`desktop-mode="over"`).

members.name: handleToggleClick
members.description: Click delegation for `[side-nav-toggle]` elements anywhere in the light DOM (drawer or content).

members.name: drawerInert
members.description: In side mode a collapsed drawer with a non-zero closed width is a rail and must stay interactive.

events.name: opened-change
events.description: Fired when the user or a breakpoint change opens or closes the drawer (not when `opened` is set from code). `detail.opened` is the new state.

attributes.name: opened
